name: georankle-video-pipeline
description: Enregistre l'app mobile jouée comme un humain, et rend des vidéos App Store / Play / social.

scripts.build:app: cd .. && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir video-pipeline/.dist
scripts.compose:sync: mkdir -p compose/assets/clips && cp out/${DEVICE:-iphone69}/clips/*.mp4 compose/assets/clips/ && cp out/${DEVICE:-iphone69}/tour.json compose/assets/tour.json
scripts.compose:check: cd compose && HYPERFRAMES_FFMPEG_PATH=$(node -p "require('ffmpeg-static')") HYPERFRAMES_FFPROBE_PATH=$(node -p "require('ffprobe-static').path") npx hyperframes@0.8.33 check
scripts.compose:render: cd compose && HYPERFRAMES_FFMPEG_PATH=$(node -p "require('ffmpeg-static')") HYPERFRAMES_FFPROBE_PATH=$(node -p "require('ffprobe-static').path") npx hyperframes@0.8.33 render --quiet -o renders/app-preview.mp4
